text:
Anya Park: Quick heads-up — discovered failure modes in the v4 surface shim when clients send mixed websocket+http framing. Thinking we need a short-lived 'retrograde' compatibility mode on the gateway to reduce customer breakage. Thoughts?
Mike Chen: Curious—how bad is the perf hit with shim enabled? numbers?
Anya Park: Quick back-of-envelope: p50 +8%, p99 +20% under high multiplexing. It's mostly extra parsing/rewriting on the hot path. Need more profiling though.
Samir Patel: Can we avoid global rewrites? Suggestation: tenant opt-in flag + gateway header passthrough for signed tokens. Also capture client-version telemetry to drive waves.
Lisa Gonzalez: Ops worry — we can't keep the shim forever. If opt-in, need clear eviction plan, notice cadence, and a kill-switch. Also how do we surface deprecation to users?
Anya Park: Draft runbook idea:
1) Add opt-in toggle per-tenant: `compat_mode: \"retrograde\"`
2) Emit `X-Compatibility-Warning` response header for non-opted clients
3) Collect `client_version` telemetry and retention metrics
4) Prune in waves: 10%, 30%, 60% over 12 weeks
5) Final removal w/ 90-day notice + emergency rollback
Mike Chen: Can you paste a sample gateway rule?
Anya Park: sure — sample config:
```
{
  "route": "/v4/*",
  "compat": {
    "mode": "retrograde",
    "tenant_allowlist": ["t-123", "t-456"],
    "emit_header": true
  },
  "rollback_key": "retrograde-shim-disable"
}
```
Samir Patel: Need to add tests: streaming+chunked frames, reconnect semantics, grpc interop. Also add load tests for p99 impact.
Lisa Gonzalez: +1 on header `X-Compatibility-Warning: v4 will be required after 2025-06-01; see https://redwood.example.com/deprecations`
Mike Chen: Also recommend rate-limited emails to tenants with >10k req/day when we detect incompatible clients.
infra-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: canary/gateway-retrograde at 2025-01-15T03:40:00Z (CI#4021)
Anya Park: OK — I'll write RFC follow-up with timeline, telemetry dashboards, rollback criteria. Will @-mention infra and support for the notice cadence.
Mike Chen: Thanks. If you want I can add perf regression dashboard and a quick flamegraph run.
Samir Patel: I'll own the test harness for streaming frames.
Lisa Gonzalez: I'll draft the tenant communication plan.
Anya Park: Great — next sync T+2 days to finalise runbook. :thumbsup:
